# Portfolio Copilot Instructions

## UI/UX Execution Policy

- For any request touching UI, UX, layout, visual hierarchy, component styling, responsive behavior, accessibility, motion, or design systems, load and apply the `ui-ux-pro-max` skill first.
- Treat this skill as mandatory for design-related changes in this repository.
- Prioritize accessibility, responsive quality, and visual consistency checks before finalizing UI edits.
- Reject generic, boilerplate visual output; prefer intentional and product-appropriate design decisions.
